name: Pop Music Quiz
description: How well do you know pop music?
author: ChatGPT

questions.question: Which band released the album Revolver in 1966?

answers.comment: The Rolling Stones released Aftermath in 1966.
The Kinks released Face to Face in 1966.
Correct! The Beatles released Revolver in August 1966.
The Who released their debut album My Generation in 1965.

questions.question: Which band recorded the album The Dark Side of the Moon?

answers.comment: Led Zeppelin released albums including Houses of the Holy and Physical Graffiti.
Correct! Pink Floyd released The Dark Side of the Moon in 1973.
Deep Purple were known for albums such as Machine Head.
Genesis released progressive rock albums including Selling England by the Pound.

questions.question: Which group had a worldwide disco hit with Stayin' Alive?

answers.comment: ABBA had hits including Dancing Queen and Mamma Mia.
Boney M. had hits including Rivers of Babylon and Rasputin.
Chic recorded disco classics including Le Freak and Good Times.
Correct! The Bee Gees recorded Stayin' Alive for the Saturday Night Fever soundtrack.

questions.question: Who released the album Like a Virgin in 1984?

answers.comment: Cyndi Lauper released She's So Unusual in 1983.
Correct! Madonna released Like a Virgin in 1984.
Whitney Houston released her debut album in 1985.
Tina Turner released the successful album Private Dancer in 1984.

questions.question: Which band released the album The Joshua Tree in 1987?

answers.comment: Simple Minds released albums including Once Upon a Time in 1985.
Dire Straits released Brothers in Arms in 1985.
Correct! U2 released The Joshua Tree in March 1987.
The Cure released Kiss Me, Kiss Me, Kiss Me in 1987.

questions.question: Which Britpop band released the album Definitely Maybe in 1994?

answers.comment: Blur released Parklife in 1994.
Pulp released His 'n' Hers in 1994.
Suede released their self-titled debut album in 1993.
Correct! Definitely Maybe was Oasis's debut album, released in 1994.
